name: Enterprise Security Assurance Plan (ESAP)
description: A representative third-party / vendor security-assurance control catalog in the style large enterprises (Fortune-500 procurement and CISO offices) use to evaluate a provider before and during a contract. Controls are grouped into General, Application, and SaaS governance and are aligned to recognized standards (ISO/IEC 27001/27002, NIST CSF, OWASP). This is a generic, vendor-neutral reworking intended as a built-in compliance catalog for Cerberus; it names no specific company. Control 'requirement' fields below are concise machine summaries; the full verbatim methodology and requirement text live in enterprise-sap.md (the canonical human-readable catalog).

responseSchema.actionPlan: required when Partially compliant or Non-compliant
responseSchema.timeLimitDays: deadline to reach compliance (catalog guidance: standard 30 days, max 180 days)

methodology.overview: The Provider answers every control with a compliance verdict plus a detailed justification; non-compliant or partially compliant controls require an action plan with a deadline. Based on the responses, the Customer performs a vendor evaluation at its sole discretion.

correctiveActions.notes: Extensions beyond 30 days require the Customer's approval; the maximum must not exceed 180 days. Disagreements are escalated for decision.

reviewTriggers: An evolution: configuration or environment change, service-scope change, regulatory change, or contract amendment

governance.committees: Strategic committee at least annually (either party may convene); operational committees during implementation if required. Minimum participants: both parties' SPOCs.
exampleIndicators: Number of security incidents (detected and corrected)
Percentage of actions closed for each action plan

controls.title: Organization of Security
controls.requirement: Maintain an organizational structure and dedicated resources for information-systems security. Name the responsible individuals, notify the customer of changes in due time, and make security-stakeholder contacts available on request.

controls.title: Information Systems Security Policy
controls.requirement: Maintain an information-security policy covering the whole information system, enforced across all personnel and third parties (subcontractors, maintenance agents). Review and update it regularly, and make it available on request.

controls.title: Security Certification
controls.requirement: Hold and evidence recognized security certifications and their scopes (e.g. SOC 2 Type 2, ISO/IEC 27001, HITRUST CSF, FedRAMP, CSA STAR, ISO/IEC 27017/27018, PCI DSS). Provide certificates, audit reports, or statements of applicability on request.

controls.title: Risk Management
controls.requirement: Operate a formalized information-system risk-management process and implement the measures needed to manage risks incurred during the service.

controls.title: Security of Provider Sites
controls.requirement: Deploy the physical-security measures needed to meet confidentiality and continuity commitments. Restrict premises access to authorized persons, list all customer-data storage locations (primary, backup), and notify the customer of location changes.

controls.title: Confidentiality & Personnel Duties
controls.requirement: Ensure staff working on the customer scope understand and respect information-security duties. At minimum, enforce a non-disclosure agreement covering customer data (during and after employment) and an acceptable-use charter for the information system.

controls.title: Vulnerability & Patch Management
controls.requirement: Deploy automated update tooling to keep operating systems current, harden OS configurations to state-of-the-art guidelines, and run regular vulnerability scans with remediation of discovered issues.

controls.title: Change Management
controls.requirement: Operate a change-management process across the information system that preserves the security of technical and application updates and maintains service continuity.

controls.title: Security Incident Management
controls.requirement: Maintain written incident-response plans defining roles and incident-handling phases. Cooperate with customer investigations, provide regular incident reports (detected, time-to-resolution, open), notify the customer of incidents affecting service as soon as possible, permit forensics where customer data is concerned, and notify the customer's CISO of any personal-data breach within 24 hours.

controls.title: Liability Insurance
controls.requirement: Carry insurance against cyber-related damages to the customer and identify the insurer on request.

controls.title: Business Continuity
controls.requirement: Implement measures ensuring availability and continuity of the service: meet agreed RTO/RPO, maintain a business-continuity plan and disaster-recovery plan, and test both regularly.

controls.title: Audits
controls.requirement: Permit the customer to conduct organizational and/or technical audits (penetration testing, vulnerability scanning, code audit, infrastructure audit) of the components supporting the service. Collaborate, remediate discovered vulnerabilities on an agreed schedule, and make the last 12 months of audit reports available.

controls.title: Protection of Personal Data
controls.requirement: Comply with applicable personal-data protection laws for the relevant jurisdictions (e.g. GDPR, PIPEDA, applicable US state laws, Australian Privacy Act).

controls.title: Secure Log-on Procedures
controls.requirement: Deploy multi-factor authentication for access to the application.

controls.title: Password & Identity Management
controls.requirement: Prefer delegating authentication to the business identity provider via SSO. Where local authentication is used, follow OWASP password guidance and store secrets in a key vault or equivalent. Support integration with the enterprise authentication solution (SAML 2.0, Azure AD / Entra ID).

controls.title: Encryption (General)
controls.requirement: Support end-to-end encryption; offer per-customer unique keys (single tenancy); document key-management procedures; allow customer-managed keys; support pseudonymization/redaction when production data is replicated to non-production; allow tagging of sensitive data; and disallow deprecated algorithms.

controls.title: Encryption In-Transit
controls.requirement: Use TLS 1.2 or higher (prefer TLS 1.3) for all connections and disable deprecated encryption algorithms.

controls.title: Environment Separation
controls.requirement: Separate development, testing, and operational environments; continuously evaluate and improve infrastructure configuration; and ensure administrators cannot see customer data.

controls.title: Developer Awareness & Training
controls.requirement: Ensure developers are aware of major cyber threats (OWASP). Apply and verify the OWASP Top 10 before delivery.

controls.title: Development Security
controls.requirement: Operate a secure development process including acceptance tests prior to production, use of production data only in production (anonymized elsewhere), systematic code audits, and robust handling of errors, exceptions, and unexpected behavior.

controls.title: Data Territoriality
controls.requirement: Comply with the laws of the selected region and declare the territory where customer data is processed and stored.

controls.title: Pooling of Infrastructures
controls.requirement: Declare all mutualized (shared) components within the service scope and ensure customer data is not shared with other customers' data (logical and/or physical separation).

controls.title: Network Security Management
controls.requirement: Implement detection and prevention components (IDS/IPS) on incoming flows, at least two levels of filtering on all incoming flows, protection against denial-of-service attacks, and tooling to detect leaks of sensitive data (DLP).

controls.title: Connection Certificates
controls.requirement: Use valid TLS certificates from a well-known trusted CA for external connections and for internal protection of microservices; deprecated algorithms are not allowed.

controls.title: Information Access Restriction
controls.requirement: Make application information accessible only to authenticated users from approved devices that comply with the consumer's security policies.

controls.title: Downloading Controls
controls.requirement: Where information can be downloaded from the application, deploy appropriate security controls to prevent illegitimate data exfiltration.

controls.title: API-Based Access
controls.requirement: Approve any API-based access to third parties only after security checks (scan, review, consistency checks) and revoke it once the business requirement is met.

controls.title: Provider Access to Customer Data
controls.requirement: When the provider needs to access customer data, notify the customer so the request can be approved or denied.

controls.title: Data Restoration Testing
controls.requirement: Regularly test backup integrity by performing restoration, aligned with RPO/RTO requirements (default 24h if unspecified), with zero errors during backup testing.

controls.title: Information Backup
controls.requirement: Operate a backup resilience strategy with a defined lifecycle and expiration policy; store backups in immutable (WORM) form or otherwise ensure an immutable copy (air-gapped where immutability is unavailable); restrict backup access on least-privilege; protect against unwanted deletion; and apply the 3-2-1 rule (3 copies, 2 media types, 1 off-site).

controls.title: Encryption At-Rest
controls.requirement: Encrypt actively stored data and all backups at rest using strong algorithms (at least AES-256), meeting current FIPS standards and NIST SP 800-57 key-management guidance.

controls.title: Controls Against Malware
controls.requirement: Protect the information system from intrusion and malicious code; apply an anti-malware policy on all components hosting the service with automatic updates; specify the anti-virus software used on workstations and servers and its update frequency.

controls.title: Red Team & Penetration Testing
controls.requirement: Conduct regular internal and external penetration tests and Red Team exercises over the services, including a full scope of blended attacks (wireless, client-based, web application). Ensure at least one pentest within the last 12 months, make a remediation plan available, and prioritize remediation of critical vulnerabilities without delay.

controls.title: Service Availability
controls.requirement: Own data backup, redundancy, and failover for infrastructure or application-layer failures; own remediation of technical issues; and meet an uptime target of 99.99%.

controls.title: Vulnerability & Patch Management (Infrastructure)
controls.requirement: Run the most recent security updates on the delivery infrastructure, install security patches without delay, and provide on-demand summary reports of outstanding vulnerabilities.

controls.title: Archiving Policy
controls.requirement: Archive data no longer in use but still required, with specific access modalities, secure destruction of obsolete archives, and availability to the customer on request.

controls.title: Administration Activities
controls.requirement: Secure administrator-account management: authorization, revocation, and review of accounts and authorizations; specific admin logins; multi-factor authentication; robust passwords; individual (non-shared) accounts only; traceability of admin access and actions; account monitoring; and use of a dedicated machine/environment for administrative tasks.

controls.title: Traceability & Logging
controls.requirement: Collect security events, platform access logs, administration actions, account/authorization transactions, and restoration requests. Protect logging systems and data integrity, maintain primary and backup time synchronization, monitor and report tampering, be able to feed the customer's SOC, and retain logs at least 6 months (per applicable regulation).

controls.title: Reversibility / Exit
controls.requirement: On contract end or activation of the reversibility clause, assist with secure transfer of customer assets, return a complete copy of the data in a usable format (recorded, dated, signed), then anonymize recovered material and securely delete customer data and related technical information, certifying deletion in a report.
